skills.name: software-design
skills.description: Applies design principles (SOLID, composition, dependency injection, pure core) and picks the right design pattern from a symptom-to-pattern table, while guarding against over-engineering. Use when asked "which pattern", "refactor this", "this is too coupled", "SOLID", "design pattern", "OOP", "how should I structure this", or before introducing a new abstraction, class hierarchy or layer.

agents.name: design-reviewer
agents.description: Reviews a diff or a set of files for software design problems — tight coupling, god objects, missing dependency injection, leaking vendor types, and also needless patterns and pass-through layers. Read-only. Use when asked to "review the design", "is this over-engineered", "is this too coupled", or before merging a change that adds classes, layers or abstractions.
